payload.title: Cross-hardware runner: engine extras, device auto-detect, one command
payload.description: Copy the lm-evaluation-harness pattern: named backends, pip extras per engine, --device auto/mps/cpu/cuda, ONNX or GGUF fallback where a model ships one, a smoke test that loads each installed engine on one text. Document CUDA-only engines (NanoJev, Geni-S1-Ops, DiffusionGemma-derived) as not runnable here.
